import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { vec3, mix, uv, texture } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color, DoubleSide } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();
  const timelines = [];
  const disposables = [];

  // --- PALETTE ---
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  const colInk = new Color(colors.ink);
  const colPaper = new Color(colors.paper);
  const colAccent = new Color(colors.accent);
  const colSurface = new Color(colors.surface);

  // --- STAGE BACKDROP ---
  const backdropGeom = new PlaneGeometry(7.5, 6.5);
  disposables.push(backdropGeom);

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    side: DoubleSide,
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(backdropMat);

  // Gradient: Engineered gradient that flows from ink base to dark surface
  const vUv = uv();
  const gradientColor = mix(
    vec3(colSurface.r, colSurface.g, colSurface.b),
    mix(
      vec3(colInk.r, colInk.g, colInk.b),
      vec3(colSurface.r, colSurface.g, colSurface.b),
      vUv.x
    ),
    vUv.y
  );
  backdropMat.colorNode = gradientColor;

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeom, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, -1.5, -2.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // --- HERO SUBHEAD CONTAINER ---
  const container = new Group();
  container.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);
  group.add(container);

  // --- TEXT LAYOUT ---
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  let displayCopy = "Atelier Noir — precise · luxury · technical";
  if (textItems.length > 0) {
    displayCopy = textItems[0].text || displayCopy;
  }

  // Generate text through font atlas
  const textMesh = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(displayCopy, {
    fontSize: 42,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 1.2
  });
  textMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);
  container.add(textMesh);

  // Decorative Accent Bar (Signal Red representation representing the 10% limit)
  const barGeom = new PlaneGeometry(1.8, 0.02);
  disposables.push(barGeom);
  const barMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: colAccent,
    side: DoubleSide
  });
  disposables.push(barMat);
  const barMesh = new Mesh(barGeom, barMat);
  barMesh.position.set(0, -0.4, 0.1);
  container.add(barMesh);

  // --- IMAGERY / SUBJECT CARD ---
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    const planeGeom = new PlaneGeometry(4.0, 2.5);
    disposables.push(planeGeom);

    const planeMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
      transparent: true,
      side: DoubleSide,
      depthWrite: false
    });
    disposables.push(planeMat);

    const subjectMesh = new Mesh(planeGeom, planeMat);
    subjectMesh.position.set(0, -1.1, -0.2);
    container.add(subjectMesh);

    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      planeMat.colorNode = texture(tex);
      planeMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn("Could not load image texture in node:", err);
    });
  }

  // --- EXPLICIT POSITION SETUP ---
  if (config.scenePosition) {
    const { x, y, z } = config.scenePosition;
    group.position.set(x ?? 0, y ?? 1.85, z ?? 0);
  } else {
    group.position.set(0, 1.85, 0);
  }

  // --- ENTRANCE & MOTION ---
  container.position.y -= 0.3;
  container.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);

  const entranceTl = gsap.timeline();
  timelines.push(entranceTl);

  entranceTl.to(container.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 1.2,
    ease: "power4.out"
  }).to(container.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 1.4,
    ease: "power3.out"
  }, 0);

  // Idle breath animation
  const idleTl = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  timelines.push(idleTl);
  idleTl.to(container.position, {
    y: "+=0.03",
    duration: 4.5,
    ease: "sine.inOut"
  });

  // --- CLEANUP ---
  group.userData.cleanup = function() {
    timelines.forEach(t => t.kill());
    disposables.forEach(d => d.dispose());
  };

  return group;
}
